subject: MAP & evaluation: proposed velocity commit pathway and close timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightharbor.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation & MAP kickoff: BrightHarbor x Redwood

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and observability looked great. We want to move forward with a short evaluation ahead of an initial commit, and we need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties milestones to commercial milestones (pricing/commits/discounts).

Quick context: BrightHarbor is planning a staged rollout of an LLM feature to production across three product teams. Our CFO is asking for a target monthly usage plan to model spend (TPM / tokens per month). Procurement will want verified ramp commitments tied to discounted pricing.

Could you share: 1) a MAP with dates and acceptance criteria for the 30-day eval, 2) a proposed ramp (month-by-month TPM targets) and 3) what discount triggers you can offer at various commit levels?

High level constraints:
- Goal: start evaluation 02/15 and finish by 03/15
- Target first-month usage (during eval): ~25M tokens; target steady-state by Month 3: ~150M tokens/month
- Procurement needs a one-page summary for internal approvers and a PO-friendly billing cadence

Attached is a short evaluation requirements doc (BH-Eval-Req-2026.pdf) that outlines our data handling questions and SLA expectations. Happy to hop on a call with Vivek or Monica to align.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Product Strategy
BrightHarbor

Attachment: BH-Eval-Req-2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightharbor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP kickoff: BrightHarbor x Redwood

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and the eval doc. I've put together a draft MAP and a proposed commit pathway (attached). Top-level summary below so your CFO/procurement can see the economics at a glance.

Draft MAP highlights (attached: RI-MAP-proposal-v1.xlsx):
- Eval window: 2026-02-15 -> 2026-03-15 (30 days), acceptance criteria: successful integration, latency P50 < 150ms, and quality checks on 3 canonical prompts
- Month-by-month TPM (tokens per month) proposed for committed plan if you move to a MAP-to-commit after eval:
  - Month 0 (eval month): 25M tokens (uncommitted trial usage)
  - Month 1 (ramp start): 50M tokens
  - Month 2: 100M tokens
  - Month 3+: 150M tokens steady state
- Pricing & discounts (illustrative): base price $0.65 / 1k tokens; 10% discount at >=100M TPM commit; 18% discount at >=250M TPM commit; additional 5% credit if BrightHarbor meets QA milestones in the MAP within the eval window
- Proposed billing: monthly invoice based on committed TPM with reconciliation (true-up) each quarter; PO accepted prior to production ramp
- SLA asks: standard 99.9% availability for hosted endpoints; per-token latency SLOs documented in MAP

Next steps I recommend: 1) quick call this week to finalize the MAP acceptance criteria, 2) procurement questions answered inline, then 3) DocuSign SOW with the commit schedule for signature. If you want, we can include a short clawback/credit clause to protect BrightHarbor if ramp misses targets in Month 2.

I've attached the MAP spreadsheet with a gating milestones tab and a commercial tab that maps discounts to commit milestones. Let me know availability for a 30-min sync.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI-MAP-proposal-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: BrightHarbor Procurement <procurement@brightharbor.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightharbor.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP kickoff: BrightHarbor x Redwood — Procurement questions

Hi Hannah / Monica,

Procurement here. A few quick questions we need to resolve before the PO can be issued:
1) Can you confirm the billing cadence and the invoice entity? We prefer monthly invoices with 30-day terms to BrightHarbor, Inc.
2) For the committed TPMs, do you support quarterly reconciliation and credits if actual usage is below commit?
3) We need a simple clause that ties the 10% and 18% discounts to signed commit levels in the SOW. Is that standard?
4) Any penalties or credit mechanics if service availability drops below the SLA? We will need objective metrics for uptime and a list of out-of-scope events.

Also, our legal wants an appendix that says data residency remains in the US region for the evaluation period. Please confirm.

For timeline planning: procurement's internal gating requires a one-page commercial summary by 02/22 so leadership can greenlight a PO by 03/01. If you can provide that and the revised MAP with explicit billing language, we can try to hit that cadence.

Thanks,
BrightHarbor Procurement
procurement@brightharbor.com

Attachment: BH-PO-questions.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightharbor.com>, procurement@brightharbor.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP kickoff: BrightHarbor x Redwood — proposed commercial adjustments and close plan

Hi Sarah / Procurement team — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a slight commercial tweak we think will make the ramp lower-risk for both sides.

1) Billing & invoicing: monthly invoices to BrightHarbor, Inc. with Net30. Invoices will reflect committed TPM charges; we will do quarterly reconciliation (true-up or credit) against actual usage.

2) Discount triggers: we can commit to the following:
   - >=100M TPM commit: 10% off base price
   - >=250M TPM commit: 18% off base price
   - Early-close credit: if BrightHarbor signs the MAP + SOW by 2026-03-15, Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the first-quarter committed spend.

3) Missed ramp protection: we will include a protection clause — if BrightHarbor reaches less than 60% of Month 2 committed TPM, Redwood will step down discount tiers by one level and provide a pro-rated credit for the shortfall in Month 3. This protects both: BrightHarbor doesn't overpay and Redwood doesn't overly subsidize long idle capacity.

4) SLA & residency: we confirm US-region data residency for the evaluation window and standard SLA credits for availability drops (detailed metrics in the SOW appendix). We will provide monitoring dashboard access for your SREs during the eval.

5) Close timeline: to meet procurement's schedule, please confirm you want the one-page commercial summary (we can send a short PDF) by 02/22. Proposed internal target for signature on the SOW is 03/15 with production ramp starting 03/16. If we need to accelerate to 03/01 signature, we can amplify onboarding support (paid onboarding) to shorten the cutover.

Action items:
- Hannah / Monica: circulate the one-page commercial summary and the revised MAP with explicit billing clause by COB 02/22.
- Sarah / Procurement: confirm the signing target (03/15 or 03/01) and whether you prefer the early-close credit to be an invoice credit or a billing-line item.

Happy to take a 30-min alignment call early next week — Hannah, can you propose 2 slots?

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
